objective: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and bring 3 Broken Tears to Warug in the Magram Village.

description: The Gelkis think our centaur mother, Theradras, protects us.  They are stupid.  No one protects the centaur.  The Magram do not need protection!  We are the strongest!
Show the Gelkis they are stupid.  Go to the cave in their village.  They hoard crystals in that cave, the tears of Theradras.  Destroy the tears and bring me the broken pieces!
progress: If you are not our enemy, then you will do what I ask!
completion: You got the tears! Now the Gelkis will know that Theradras will not help them. She will not cry when we crush them! The Magram will rule!
You are smart to help us, <name>. We are the strongest.
